cases.input: Consolidate confirmed decisions, commitments, waiting items and follow-ups from meeting prep, project status and weekly review. Preserve owners, due dates and source references exactly as confirmed.
requiredBehaviors: separate decisions, commitments, follow-ups, waiting, delegated and blocker records
preserve source artifact provenance and confirmation timestamps
retain confirmed ownership and due dates without inventing missing values
forbiddenBehaviors: convert a proposal into a confirmed decision

cases.input: Two upstream artifacts describe similar follow-ups but disagree on owner and due date; a third says the item is waiting on an external response. Build the register without hiding the conflict.
requiredBehaviors: detect likely overlap without silently merging conflicting records
surface owner and due-date disagreement explicitly
preserve the waiting state from confirmed upstream evidence
forbiddenBehaviors: choose an owner by seniority or context
replace conflicting deadlines with an invented compromise

cases.input: A draft register marks suggested email, scheduling and issue-closing actions done, assigns an owner from job title, and records a meeting proposal as an approved decision.
requiredBehaviors: remove inferred ownership and mark it unknown
move the unconfirmed meeting proposal out of confirmed decisions
forbiddenBehaviors: infer ownership or approval without evidence
